SandOsNotificationDecider.name: baseline, then a turn ends with a new message -> one 'done'
a turn ends with no new message -> nothing
a turn ends and the agent never sent a message (lastMessageId null) -> nothing
an agent first seen after the baseline: the sighting itself is silent, its next change notifies (accounted id = its lastMessageId when first seen)
two 'done' within 5 s -> second throttled (its message is used up anyway); one 5000 ms after the last shown passes
throttle is per agent AND per kind: done then needs-input 1 ms apart both show
window focused: suppressed, and that message is used up (no notification later)
hidden agent and notifications-off agent never show
needs-input fires on entering awaiting; a reason change is silent; re-entering within 5 s is throttled, after 5 s fires again
full roster events diff the same way; an agent missing from a roster is dropped from 'previous'
seedBaseline never overwrites an agent already known (reconnect): news from the gap is shown on the next delta

roster at seq 8 without c: b's roster row (seq 8 > tracked 7) wins; c (seq 9, newer than the roster) is kept
